picks.title: Coinone Warns of Identity Theft After Support Breach
picks.summary: Passwords, bank details and national ID numbers shared with support may be exposed. Coinone says it has found no evidence of direct intrusion into its account, trading or wallet systems.

picks.title: TSMC employee data breach linked to cloud provider
picks.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) confirmed that personal employee data has been leaked online after a threat actor put 6.9GB of information allegedly stolen from the company up for auction. [...]

picks.title: Cursor confirms security breach led to malicious Claude Code extension
picks.summary: Cursor confirmed it suffered a security breach that let hackers distribute a malicious Claude Code extension through its marketplace after stealing credentials from AI infrastructure provider Fireworks AI. [...]

picks.title: Your Agent Will Pick the Hackable One
FBI disrupts North Korean FaceStealer campaign behind $5 billion Binance hack
picks.summary: US DoJ partially disrupts FaceStealer campaign that s taken $400m from victims and threatens open-source software — gov techs disrupt cloud infrastructure and find 900 videos of targeted tech workers

picks.title: FBI warns ARTEX AI hacking tool is powering global cyberattacks
picks.summary: The FBI is warning that hackers are using an AI-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX to automate cyberattacks against organizations worldwide, including a recent ConnectWise supply-chain breach that compromised Microsoft 365 customer environments. [...]

picks.title: Dev hacks Coway air purifier to cut it off from the cloud
picks.summary: A developer reverse-engineered his Coway Airmega IconS air purifier to run it locally in Home Assistant, without Coway’s cloud.

picks.title: Kava Lend loses roughly $3.8 million to hack, sending KAVA token down nearly 40%
picks.summary: About 49.2 million KAVA was bridged to BNB Chain via LayerZero and sold for roughly $2.1 million in BNB and USDT.

picks.title: Meta tests prediction-market app, DOJ moves to seize $1.2 billion from Binance hack, and more
picks.summary: In today s newsletter, Meta tests prediction-market app using points instead of cash; DOJ moves to seize $1.2 billion from Binance hack, disrupts North Korean deepfake scheme; and more.

picks.title: Judge denies motion to dismiss DRAM price-fixing lawsuit against Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix, finds evidence of DRAM collusion plausible after 500% price surge
picks.summary: The judge characterized the three companies as hawks flying in formation when it came to their business decisions.

picks.title: Louisiana AG calls CFTC chair an ‘obsequious standard bearer’ for prediction markets following agency lawsuit
picks.summary: The CFTC sued Louisiana Friday to block a state judge s order banning 31 prediction markets, including Kalshi and Polymarket, in the state.

picks.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Other AI Giants Face Lawsuit Demanding Development Freeze
picks.summary: Four nonprofit advocacy groups want a California court to stop major AI developers from building stronger models, alleging their technology could cause catastrophic harm worldwide.
